text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle Series.
The 'Holy Sword' carved through the era.
However...
Even that has now become a distant memory...

All alone, I stood before my knight's monument.
Even if the era forgets, I never will.
Looking back, she truly was a wonderful Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Demon Dragon, become a sacrifice for Villandry!
Always so dignified—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my King. Durandal is in awe
of your profound insight.
Always humble—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see the children smile...
I always think to myself,
these children truly are the treasures of our kingdom.
choice_data_list: Huh? Did I have a memory like this?

text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. Let's just pretend it happened.
Always full of benevolence, and...

"A truly perfect knight. Flawless in every
way... right?"

If only she were still with us now,
how secure the kingdom would be.
(*glug, glug, glug...*)

"Durandal, I will never forget you.
Never, for all eternity—"
Alright, cut!
And so, the little play came to an end. We gave it our all, but...
choice_data_list: How was it? I gave it everything I had, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My King, I thank you for granting my request.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It truly is... delightful, isn't it?
To still be held dear by the King, even after departing.

Naturally, Durandal had no intention of going anywhere.
She only put on this performance because she had been explicitly requested to do so.
It was in response to her wish: "I want to be remembered and honored so much!" as a reward for working hard over three years.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Of course, it wasn't bad, but if I'm being ambitious...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Your delivery is monotone! Your memory is hazy! And sometimes you sound like you're asking questions!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Could this be an area for improvement? As our King,
I have faith you will overcome it in time.
choice_data_list: Overcome it...? We have to do that again?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would like to request this once a year.
So that I may thoroughly reflect upon my work.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, O King, let us return to Tracen Academy.
Come, this way.
choice_data_list: Over there? Isn't that the opposite direction...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, let's take a sightseeing detour
through the town on our way back. Naturally—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, Durandal, shall guard you on your journey.
Please rest assured.
choice_data_list: I-I wouldn't mind just heading straight home, though...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No... Even though it's such a rare opportunity...
I'm sure the people were looking forward to it as well...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought this would finally be
a chance to fulfill my duty, too...
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it. Then shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As you command! That is so.
That is truly my King!

"Durandal loves escorting me... or rather,
she loves walking together with me.
She always strides gallantly ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, the way ahead is clear.
Please proceed with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to entrust
your protection to me.
Look at that smug face. Durandal looks so truly proud of herself when she's protecting me—

The march alongside my knight continues.
Aiming ever onward, toward unfulfilled victory.
